sources.beta: Rs 345 = one day of the Tamil Nadu wage for unskilled manual work, Ministry of Rural Development notification of 30 June 2026 under Section 10 of the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 (effective 1 July 2026). Checked 17 Oct 2026 via SCC Online's report of the notification; docs/policy.md CLAUSE-05.
sources.stipend_cap: Rs 3,000 = 50% of the Rs 6,000 per family Cyclone Michaung flood-relief cash assistance (Tamil Nadu Revenue and Disaster Management Department G.O., December 2023). Amount checked 17 Oct 2026 in DT Next and Deccan Herald reports; the G.O. number was not found, so none is cited. docs/policy.md CLAUSE-05.
sources.tau, tau_review, theta_mule, zone_hold_n: Chosen from artifacts/engine_tune.json (engine.tune on the v2 held-out split, 9,408 rows, Model A-xgb-iso-1 / B-mlp-1, beta 345). With the zone rule on and theta_mule 0.8: tau 250 had the lowest fraud leakage of the grid (1.74% of fraud rupees; tau 500 is next); tau_review 0 has the same leakage as 250 but legitimate REVIEWs of 2.2% instead of 5.9%; theta_mule 0.8 kept (0.9 lowers legitimate collector-donation holds from 12.1% to 9.3% but raises leakage to 1.97%). zone_hold_needs_mule true is a policy choice: victims left with Rs 0 1.33% -> 0.07% (mule-flagged only), fraud leakage 0.38% -> 1.74% of fraud rupees (capped at one stipend per payment), syndicate HOLD 97.5% -> 82.2% (the rest REVIEW with escrow), and on the independent eval file takeovers that spoof the zone go from 69.4% HOLD to 0% (ATO leakage Rs 2.52 lakh -> Rs 4.28 lakh; see models/MODEL_CARD.md). Set false to restore the plan's table as written.
sources.alpha, urgency_by_category: Not tuned separately; alpha is swept in the sim Pareto run (artifacts/sim/pareto.json).
